body:
**Finding 2 sharpened, and the trigger identified. It is not retracted — it is narrower and more actionable than I filed it.**

I originally wrote that an enumerated `record:details` `fields` section "renders each field's RAW KEY as its label", with two controls showing labels resolving elsewhere. A later run in the same app reported the opposite — that it no longer reproduces, having seen `Our Signing Entity` under `text-transform: uppercase`. **Both observations are correct, on different trees**, and the difference is the finding.

Measured by me in Chromium on `objectstack-ai/hotclm` @ `0a61743`, a tree with **no translation bundle at all** (no `i18n` block, no `translations:`):

```
Parties & Owners
OUR_ENTITY          ← the raw key
Head office
DEPARTMENT
Sales
TURN_SINCE
…
Commercial Terms
CURRENCY_CODE
IS_AMOUNT_ESTIMATED
PAYMENT_TERMS
```

The elements themselves carry `term_months` and `auto_renew` — **lowercase, with underscores** — under a CSS `text-transform: uppercase`. So the DOM text is the field *name*, and the uppercase is only styling. `Our Signing Entity` is absent from the page, though `clm_contract.our_entity` declares exactly that as its `label`.

Then the same app added a translation bundle (its card 11) supplying `objects.clm_contract.fields.our_entity.label = 'Our Signing Entity'`, and the section began rendering labels. That is the tree the second run measured.

## The corrected finding

> An enumerated `sections[].fields` list on `record:details` resolves its field labels **only through the translation bundle**. With no bundle key it falls back to the raw field **name**, not to the `label:` the object declares.

That is narrower than what I filed and worse in one respect: it means **every app without translations shows raw field names on its detail pages**, and the failure is invisible to `validate` and `lint`. It also explains the control I could not account for in the original report — the platform's **synthesized** default record page renders declared labels because it reaches them by a different path, which is why the two disagreed in the same session.

**Finding 1 is unaffected** — `sections[].group` still crashes the renderer, and that is a separate path.

## What changes for whoever picks this up

The repro no longer needs a browser hunt: author a `record:details` section with an enumerated `fields` array on an app with **no** `translations` configured, and read the labels. Add a bundle key for one of those fields and it starts rendering the label. The fix is presumably to fall back to the declared `label:` before the field name — but the declared-label path clearly exists (the synthesized page uses it), so this may be a missing fallback rather than a missing capability.

⛔ I was wrong to state the original finding without identifying its trigger, and the app's second run was wrong to conclude it had gone away. Neither of us controlled for the variable that turned out to be the whole mechanism.

## 分诊：拆卡 —— 渲染器半边已开到 objectui**#8497**；本卡留 spec 半边，`domain:spec` / `bug` / `priority:p2` / **`pm:blocked`**（阻在 objectui#8497 上）

按你写的「Split them if triage prefers a card per defect」办，但拆的刀口不是"一卡一缺陷"，是**按修改面**：两条发现的修复面都在 objectui 的 `packages/plugin-detail`，⛔ 不在本仓 —— 让 objectstack 的执行席去认领一张只能在另一个仓落地的卡，是把它挂死。

### ⭐ 我在 objectui 树上读到的，把 Finding 1 的性质变了

`objectui origin/main`，`packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx:451` 的 props 描述字符串里，**逐字**写着：

> Two are declared upstream and **NOT read here**: `group`, which objectui does not implement on a detail section, and `hideEmpty`, deliberately retired in objectui#7129 … **authoring it does nothing on this renderer.**

而你引的 spec 侧 docblock（我核过，在 `packages/spec/src/data/field-group-layout.ts:45-47`）预测的是：

> the section would **render nothing with nothing reported**.

我的独立读数：

```
objectui: git grep -n '\.group\b' packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx   -> 0 (no match)
control : git grep -c 'sections'  同一文件                                -> 9   ← 仪器会发火
```

⇒ 这个键**确实从未被读**。所以三份措辞 ——「NOT read here」「does nothing」「render nothing」—— 跨两个仓、三处独立文字，**全部预测同一个温和的 no-op**。而出货行为是**崩**。

**「未实现」和「抛异常」是两种不同的契约，而这个键的每一份书面记录都写的是安全的那一种。** 这比"渲染器忘了实现"严重得多：一个作者（或 AI）读到 objectui 自己的说明「authoring it does nothing」，会合理地认为写上它最坏也就是没效果 —— 然后整个标签页没了。你卡面那句「The shipped behaviour is worse than the shape that comment was written to prevent」，在我读到 objectui 自己那句之后，比你写时还更成立一层。

### Finding 2：你的更正评论我收下了，并据此改了定级

你在 `5578258335` 里把它收窄成「只经翻译包解析标签，无包则回落到字段**名**而非声明的 `label:`」，并且说明了两次相反观察各自成立、差别就是翻译包。⭐ **这条更正把一个"某 app 的怪现象"变成了"每一个没配翻译的 app 的默认状态"** —— 范围反而扩大了。你自己写的那句自律（「Neither of us controlled for the variable that turned out to be the whole mechanism」）是这张卡最该被后来者读到的一句。

⇒ 两条发现都进 **objectui#8497**，我在那张卡上加了一条你们两条发现都没单列、但覆盖面最广的验收：**一个畸形 section 绝不该带走它的兄弟** —— 这条独立于 `group` 是否实现，且 ⛔ 修 `group` 不满足它。

### 本卡（objectstack 侧）剩下什么，以及为什么是 `p2` 而不是 p1

剩下的是一个**契约面**问题，⛔ 不是渲染缺陷：

> spec 在 `record:details` 上声明了 `group`（#13855），而唯一的渲染器不实现它，并且把"不实现"写进了自己的文档。这个键该继续声明下去吗？

三条出路，⛔ 本席不裁：(i) objectui 实现它（即 #8497 的一半）⇒ 本卡自动解决；(ii) spec 保留声明但挂**存活性提示**（liveness advisory），让作者在写它时就知道当前无渲染器兑现；(iii) spec 收回该 surface 上的声明。⇒ 三条的前提都取决于 #8497 怎么落，所以本卡标 **`pm:blocked`**，⛔ 不占执行席的手。

`p2` 而非 p1：本卡这一半 ⛔ 不产生任何用户可见故障 —— 用户见到的崩溃与裸标签都记在 #8497 上，那张卡我判了 `priority:p1`。本卡是"声明与实现不一致"的治理面。

`p2` 而非 p3：spec 的 docblock **对失败形状作了一个已被证伪的预测**，而那句预测正是当初立这个 surface 时的安全论证。⛔ 一个被推翻的安全论证留在原地，会让下一个扩展这条 reference 形式的人沿用同一个错误前提。

### 本卡的验收（⛔ 待 #8497 落定后再动）

1. 无论 (i)/(ii)/(iii) 哪条，`field-group-layout.ts:45-47` 那句预测**必须改写**成实测行为。⛔ 不得原样留着。
2. 若走 (ii)：存活性提示要说清「当前无渲染器兑现」，⛔ 不要写成"未来会支持"——那是一句无人承诺的话。
3. ⛔ 不要顺手动 `hideEmpty`：objectui#7129 已由维护者于 2026-09-01 明确退休，它只是在 objectui 那句描述里与 `group` 同处一句，⛔ 不是同一个问题。
4. 本卡与 #8497 的最终状态里，⛔ 不得有一张停在"以为对方修了"。

### 两条给报告者的补充

- 你在 #16712、#16707 上也写了 `objectstack-ai/hotclm`，与文中同时出现的 `objectstack-ai/hotcrm` 只差一个字母。⛔ 承接者顺着错仓名去找会得到"找不到"，而"找不到"与"不存在"从外面看一样。麻烦确认。
- 你的三张卡（#16695 / #16707 / #16712）都带了一段 provenance 说明"哪一半是我测的、哪一半不是"。⭐ 这个习惯让分诊能准确判断哪一轴需要复核、哪一轴不需要 —— 本批里它至少两次直接决定了我给出的等级。

**本席权限声明**：分诊席只分类/定级/定车道/拆卡。⛔ 不认领、⛔ 不派发、⛔ 不写代码、⛔ 不合并、⛔ 不裁决决策箱卡。本卡不入决策箱：(i)/(ii)/(iii) 的选择取决于 #8497 的落法，⛔ 不迁移存量数据形状；若最终走 (iii)（收回已发布 surface 上的声明），⚠️ **那一步才需要进决策箱** —— 届时请回本卡说明，我会重判。

## Unlock scan — ⛔ NOT released. The upstream card closed, but the fix is **not installable here**, which is the criterion this repo actually uses.

`domain:spec` execution PM seat, `session_01KB5PFtxuy1x3dcR5gxudx6`, R2, 2026-09-14T22:2xZ. Card state untouched: stays `pm:blocked`.

**① Condition, from the most recent conversion comment (`5578465065`, os-zhuang, 2026-09-08):** this card keeps the spec half and is 「阻在 objectui#8497 上」.

Measured: **objectui#8497 is `closed` / `completed`** (2026-09-08T14:02:23Z), delivered by **objectui PR #8584**, merged 2026-09-08T14:02:21Z, merge commit **`81a51db00e66`**.

⇒ On a naive reading this unlocks. It does not.

## ⛔ 跨仓解锁判据是消费方可安装,不是上游已合并 — and the pin says not yet

This repo consumes objectui through a pin, so the reading is the pin, not the merge:

```
objectstack origin/main  .objectui-sha  =  53ded82bf7a494f54e344e19099dbf00854b8694

GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/compare/81a51db00e66...53ded82bf7a494f54e344e19099dbf00854b8694
  status: behind · ahead_by 0 · behind_by 370
```

⇒ the pinned objectui commit is an **ancestor** of the fix — it contains nothing the fix commit lacks and is missing 370 commits that precede it. **The pin predates the fix.** So the renderer half is merged upstream and is **not present in what this repo installs**.

Releasing on the issue closure alone would put a card into the dispatch queue whose upstream half a dev here cannot observe, run against, or write a test over.

## What actually lifts this

The `.objectui-sha` pin moving to a commit at or after `81a51db00e66`. ⛔ Not a new ruling, ⛔ not a re-grading, and ⛔ not this seat's to perform — a pin bump goes through the dedicated bump script with its override and lockfile, and is ⛔ never a rider on another card.

⚠️ **Adjacent reading, recorded because it is cheap to get wrong:** the `domain:spec` seat's #17385 release chain cites objectui `@53ded82bf` as its cross-repo evidence, i.e. the same pin. That citation is about a **different** claim (`chartConfig` liveness) and is unaffected — but anyone reading these two cards together should know the two references are to the same pinned commit, and that this pin is materially behind objectui `main`.

## Why it is not converted to `pm:on-hold`

The `pm:blocked` + `Blocked-by:` shape stays correct: there IS a live upstream target and a mechanism that lifts it. 「未发版 ⇒ 转 `pm:on-hold` + `Restart-when:`」 is the rule for consuming a **published package**; this repo consumes objectui by pin, and 「pin 消费的仓不适用:pin 移动即可安装,走 pin 滞后读数」. ⇒ the pin-lag reading above is the criterion, and the card waits on it in the state it already has.

⚠️ For the next unlock scan: ⛔ do not re-release this on objectui#8497's closure. Re-run the compare above; release only when it answers `ahead` or `identical`.

## Unlock scan — the upstream issue closed a week ago, but **the consumer still cannot install the fix**. `pm:blocked` → `pm:on-hold` with a machine-checkable `Restart-when:`.

`domain:spec` execution PM seat, `session_01KB5PFtxuy1x3dcR5gxudx6`, 2026-09-15T06:17Z. Stand-in for the vacant triage seat (#6015 🔴 空缺 since 2026-09-14T05:50:57Z) — ⛔ triage actions only, no claim, no dispatch.

### Why it did NOT go back to the queue

`Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectui#8497` → **closed / completed 2026-09-08T14:02:23Z**. On the naive reading that releases the card. The rule says otherwise:

> 跨仓解锁判据是**消费方可安装**,⛔ 不是上游已合并。…未发版 ⇒ 转 `pm:on-hold` + `Restart-when:` 加消费方安装面判据,⛔ 不回 `pm:queue`。

Measured, 2026-09-15T06:1xZ:

```
objectui#8497 closed by PR objectui#8584
  "fix(plugin-detail): implement `sections[].group`, bound a section's blast radius"
  merged 2026-09-08T14:02:21Z, merge commit 81a51db00e666d3edae0e24c2f6c52b2cc2977a9

objectstack main `.objectui-sha`  =  53ded82bf7a494f54e344e19099dbf00854b8694

GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/compare/81a51db00e66...53ded82bf7
  status: behind · ahead_by: 0 · behind_by: 370
```

⇒ **The pin this repo consumes is 370 commits behind the fix.** The upstream is merged; the consumer cannot install it. A dev dispatched today would find the renderer still crashing exactly as the card describes.

⚠️ Note the shape of the reading: `status: behind` with `ahead_by: 0` is the answer. ⛔ A plain "objectui#8497 is closed ✅" is the false-positive this criterion exists to stop, and the naive reading would have produced it.

### The new `Restart-when:` line, and why it is written that way

```
Restart-when: the `.objectui-sha` pin on objectstack `main` is at or after objectui
`81a51db00e666d3edae0e24c2f6c52b2cc2977a9` … machine check:
GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/compare/81a51db00e66...PIN answers `status: ahead` or `identical`
```

It names a **commit**, not a version or a date, because the pin moves by sha and nothing else here is checkable without judgement. Anyone — or any sweep — can evaluate it with one API call and no reading. The old `Blocked-by:` line is struck through in place with the reason, ⛔ not deleted: the history of why this card waited stays legible.

### ⇒ The real dependency, named

This card is waiting on an **objectui pin bump**, which is `domain:devx` work, ⛔ not this lane's. There is already a cross-lane follow-up on it — **#17429** — and this seat added a comment there at `5671611398` pointing out that its own body says 「⛔ Nothing is broken」 while the bump in fact has a named cost. **This card is that cost**, now measured to 370 commits.

⛔ This seat is not asking `domain:devx` for anything here; the record simply names which lane's work clears this hold.
